| Latency median / p95 | 0.1 ms / 1858.2 ms |

Latency is wall-clock time for one enrichment attempt and is the only figure here that
varies between runs of the deterministic provider — the first call absorbs JIT warm-up, so
p95 moves by tens of milliseconds while every other measure is byte-identical. It is
reported rather than suppressed, but it is not a meaningful benchmark of anything.

## Reading these numbers

The fixtures are synthetic, written for this repository, and labelled by its author
rather than by a domain expert or by consensus. Sixteen cases is far too few for a
confidence interval worth quoting. What the set is good for is detecting a regression:
if a prompt or classifier change makes these scores drop, something got worse.
Treat any single figure here as a smoke test, not as a measurement of geopolitical
classification ability.
